statement: The landing preflight silent-catch runner no longer crashes on changed paths that no longer exist in the worktree: silentCatchProblems in scripts/solve/landing-preflight.js filters deleted/absent files exactly as staticQualityProblems already does, so a Quest whose candidate includes a file deletion can mint a review manifest instead of dying on fs.stat ENOENT. doneWhen: solve/oracle/solver-landing-preflight-deleted-path-filter.json is done only when a focused test proves a manifest containing a deleted path passes the preflight silent-catch stage while existing violating paths still fail closed.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
